name: Dot-field resolve to photo
description: A sparse field of coloured dots multiplies and resolves into a full photo.

recipe.build: Canvas grid of N dots; each dot's radius and colour tween from noise to the sampled photo colour with a distance-from-centre delay; at the end crossfade to the real img.

use_when: First reveal of the generated hero image or of the product's output.
avoid: Do not use with a flat, low-detail image (nothing to resolve).
